memories.summary: Session expiry checks previously failed at exact expiration boundaries.
A prior review missed milliseconds-versus-seconds conversion in token lifetime code.

files.src/auth/session.ts: export function isSessionValid(session) { const ttl = session.expiresAt - session.createdAt; return ttl > Date.now() - session.createdAt; }
files.src/middleware/permissions.ts: export function authorize(session) { if (!isSessionValid(session)) return deny(); return allow(); }
